flags.why: In this example, trượt nước names the activity of sliding down a water slide, rather than the slide itself.
The example defines the title instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Trưởng công chúa bước vào cung điện. = The grand princess entered the palace.

flags.why: The sense illustrated here disparages someone for ostentatious wealth and needs a derogatory warning ([usage discussion](https://www.nguyentruongto.info/index.php/bao-chi/vn/19832-thoi-tru-ng-gi)).
Trạng huống belongs to formal or literary writing, so uncommon alone does not warn against casual use.
